Verifying an envelope proves the key signed this id. It does not prove the key was allowed to act for the operator: that is rung 8.
entries.record.envelope.foot.shared: A capsule may carry zero, one or several envelopes; each verifies on its own; none is in the id's preimage, so adding a signer never changes capsule_id. Verifying an envelope proves the key signed this id. It does not prove the key was allowed to act for the operator: that is rung 8.
